QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Guilt
QuestInfo.0: Ullan, usually very lively, is standing at the corner looking despondent. Talk to Ullan.
QuestInfo.1: Ullan regrets the way she behaved when she was younger, and she blames herself for Blanche's disappearance.
